title: GLUCO-T2D: oral GLP-1 agonist in adults with type 2 diabetes
criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Adults aged 18 to 75 years (inclusive).
2. Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
3. HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.5% at screening.
4. Body mass index of 40 kg/m2 or less.
5. Fasting plasma glucose of 270 mg/dL or less.
Exclusion Criteria:
1. eGFR below 45 mL/min/1.73m2.
2. Currently pregnant or planning pregnancy.
3. Current use of insulin.
4. Myocardial infarction or stroke within the past 6 months.

title: PRESSURE-HTN: once-daily combination therapy for uncontrolled hypertension
criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Age 40 to 80 years.
2. Diagnosis of essential hypertension.
3. Systolic blood pressure between 140 and 179 mmHg.
4. Body weight of at least 50 kg.
Exclusion Criteria:
1. eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2.
2. Diagnosis of heart failure.
3. Current use of spironolactone.
4. Currently pregnant.

title: RENAL-PROTECT: SGLT2 inhibitor in moderate chronic kidney disease
criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Age 18 to 80 years.
2. Diagnosis of chronic kidney disease.
3. eGFR between 25 and 60 mL/min/1.73m2.
4. Either type 2 diabetes or hypertension.
Exclusion Criteria:
1. History of kidney transplant.
2. Currently receiving dialysis.
3. Currently pregnant.

title: HER2-BRIDGE: targeted therapy for HER2-positive breast cancer
criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
1. Female sex.
2. Age 18 years or older.
3. Diagnosis of breast cancer.
4. HER2-positive tumour status.
Exclusion Criteria:
1. Active brain metastases.
2. Currently pregnant.
3. Prior treatment with doxorubicin.
4. eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2.
